items.title: The future of sustainability is more globally distributed
items.summary: Across new research from GlobeScan and BSR, sustainability professionals at large companies have described an environment in which sustainability efforts are becoming more focused — with a deeper emphasis on compliance , tighter resources and a narrower set of priorities .

items.title: Next steps for Non-EU Groups in Scope of the CSRD | Proskauer - Regulatory & Compliance
In numbers: How the UK’s energy mix is changing
items.summary: For the second year in a row, renewables accounted for over half of the UK's energy mix, with fossil fuels making up less than a third of total generation according to new figures from the Government.

items.title: Tesco, Danone and WWF join calls for PM to back ‘Good Food Billl’
items.summary: More than 100 organisations have signed a letter to the Prime Minister (PM) calling for a ‘Good Food Bill’ to increase national food security and improve health, with signatories including Tesco, Sainsbury’s, Aldi and Waitrose.

items.title: SBTi launches consultation to shape revised FLAG Standard
items.summary: The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) has issued a call for industry feedback as it looks to update its Forest, Land and Agriculture (FLAG) Standard.
